capabilities: Open .xlsx and .ods files in a dedicated read-only table view
Switch between sheets via sheet tabs
Filter visible rows by searching across cells
Show cached/formatted formula values without evaluating formulas
Render the first 10,000 rows with warnings about omitted content
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README states it makes no network requests, and ODS previews enforce size limits (32 MiB archive, 4,096 entries, 8 MiB content.xml).
motivation: The author built it for quick inspection of AI-generated spreadsheets, exports, and reference files inside a vault, to avoid leaving the vault for a quick look.
problem: Obsidian cannot display spreadsheet files, so inspecting a workbook's values requires leaving the vault for Excel or LibreOffice Calc.

relations.evidence: XLSX Viewer uses read-excel-file to read .xlsx workbook data.
.ods files are read with fflate to unpack the archive
For beta testing, install the plugin with BRAT using this repository URL

summary: Read-only viewer that opens .xlsx and .ods workbooks as value tables with sheet tabs, cell search, and row limits inside Obsidian.
